cli.description: zapwebp — SVG → WebP, safe, reversible, and scoped.
cmd.init: Set up config, ignore rules, and .gitignore
cmd.audit: Dry-run + safety audit report or command linter
cmd.check: CI mode: exit 1 if any conversion is needed
cmd.explain: Explain why a file will or won't convert
cmd.ignored: Explain why files are skipped by ignore rules
cmd.undo: Revert the last run (or a specific transaction)
cmd.gc: Prune old journal logs and backups
cmd.inspect: Analyze image container and metadata chunks
flag.fit: Fitting mode: contain, cover, fill, inside, outside
flag.clean: Strip AI provenance and metadata (default: true)
flag.verify_clean: Enforce 0 metadata chunks and Clean Certificate
flag.assert_alpha: Strictly fail if transparent input loses alpha
flag.lock_target: Enforce many-to-one conversion to specified format
flag.strict: Strictly fail on unconvertible inputs (default when locked)
flag.override_lock: Explicit opt-in to bypass configured target lock
flag.zip: Bundle outputs into a single ZIP archive
flag.changed: Only convert files modified vs HEAD (git)
flag.staged: Only convert files in git staging area
flag.include_all: Bypass all ignore layers including built-ins
flag.allow_unsafe: Permit SVGs with minor safety warnings
flag.force_undo: Force undo even if outputs were modified
flag.dry_run: Plan conversion without writing files or journal
flag.lang: Set interface and message language (e.g. en, tl)
